newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate jumps 380 bps on cenbank action.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate jumps 380 bps on cenbank action.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate was catapulted 380 basis points skyward to 24.00 percent at midafternoon Friday after the central bank drained liquidity from a skittish market at high rates, dealers said.

Banco de Mxico drained 3.658 billion pesos from a market where many dealers said liquidity was tight, through three direct Cetes sales and six repurchase agreements. The last of the repos was assigned overnight at a rate of 23.40 percent.
The overnight Cetes rate had stood at around 21.20 percent just before the operations, and shot up 280 basis points.
"Secondary market rates began to climb after Banco de Mxico intervened. We could feel liquidity was tight and that is why they assigned at such high rates," a trader said.
Analysts said deals totalling 430 million pesos had been settled for overnight paper at 24.00 percent, and thus ruled out a momentary spike.
"Volume has been representative, it is not just an odd trade," one fixed-income analyst said.
"Market rates had been moving upwards, but gradually. Now they have gone up too far," he added.
